[[File:Georgio.png|thumb|250px|Georgio]] '''Georgio''' (Japanese: '''ツトム''' ''Tsutomu'') is a [[character of the day]] in [[Pokémon Chronicles]], who appeared in ''[[HS11|A Date with Delcatty!]]''. He is a fairly shy and nice young man who lives in [[Cerulean City]]. Georgio sent a letter to {{an|Misty}}, asking her to meet him at the lighthouse. Upon meeting Misty, who was accompanied by {{an|Casey}}, he asked her to go on a date with him. Misty was taken aback by this and very hesitant to respond, but Georgio challenged her to a battle. If he won, Misty would go with him to the Electabuzz vs. Starmies [[baseball]] game, but if he lost, Misty didn't have to date him. Just as the battle began, however, [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]] stole his {{p|Delcatty}} and tried to escape. However, Georgio's {{p|Pelipper}}, [[Misty's Corsola]], and [[Casey's Meganium]] defeated them with relative ease. After rescuing Delcatty from Butch and Cassidy, Georgio and Misty resumed their battle. Misty narrowly won and promised that she and Georgio would battle again someday. However, Casey wanted to go to the baseball game, and she had to battle Georgio for the ticket. Although Casey and her {{p|Elekid}} lost, Georgio still decided to take her to the game as thanks for helping him get his Delcatty back. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Georgio's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Georgio |pkmn=Pelipper |type1=Water |type2=Flying |img=Georgio Pelipper.png |epnum=HS11 |epname=A Date With Delcatty |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Pelipper}} was first used to deliver Georgio's letter to Misty at the [[Cerulean Gym]]. Later, Pelipper was used to help rescue Delcatty from Butch and Cassidy. Pelipper's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Georgio |pkmn=Delcatty |type1=Normal |img=Georgio Delcatty.png |epnum=HS11 |epname=A Date With Delcatty |vajp=Rikako Aikawa |vaen=Rikako Aikawa |desc={{p|Delcatty}} is Georgio's main battling Pokémon. It went up against [[Misty's Corsola]]. However, before the battle happened, Butch and Cassidy of Team Rocket stole Delcatty. Georgio, Misty, and Casey were able to stop them and get Delcatty back and the battle was resumed. Delcatty knows a good variety of moves as in Double Team but despite that, it lost to Corsola. Delcatty was also used against Casey's {{p|Elekid}} where it was able to defeat Elekid, despite the previous battle it had with Corsola. Delcatty's known moves are {{m|Double Team}}, {{m|Iron Tail}}, {{m|Double-Edge}}, and {{m|Ice Beam}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=阪口大助 ''[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]]'' |en=[[Wayne Grayson]] |es_la=Héctor Emmanuel Gómez |es_eu=Nacho Aldeguer}} ==Trivia== * In the original Japanese version, Misty rejected Georgio because "there was someone else". * Georgio may be based on the male character Misty can be seen with on {{rt|25|Kanto}} in {{game3|Gold and Silver|Pokémon Gold, Silver,|s}} {{v2|Crystal}}, {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|HeartGold, and SoulSilver|s}}.
